Lemma
[Existence of an asymptotic cylinder] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0111, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0112 ↗ prop:chow-iv-isoperimetric-loop-bounds ↗ lem:chow-iv-isoperimetric-region-areas 1. ch29:29.24\group Backward Geometry

For $t_i\to -\infty $, minimizers $\gamma _{t_i}$, and $p_i\in \gamma _{t_i}$, a subsequence of $(S^2,g(t+t_i),p_i)$ converges smoothly to a static flat cylinder. The loops converge to an embedded geodesic cross-section, so sufficiently old minimizing loops are centers of arbitrarily good necks.
